name: light-mood-simple
description: Simple ladder for the lighting mood presets feature (UX round-3 #3, lightMoodPresets flag, simple tier): confirms it's on by default in Simple mode, places a table lamp + ceiling light in a night scene with Lights forced on, probes the live scene-graph PointLight intensities under Normal vs Movie night vs Romantic (proving the mood composes on top of lightsMode and dims the ceiling fixture harder than the lamp), screenshots each mood for pixel-level warmth/brightness comparison, then toggles the flag off via setFeatureFlag to confirm the Scene menu's Mood row disappears.

steps.name: dismiss-overlays
steps.eval: (() => { try { localStorage.setItem('hdb_onboarded','1') } catch {}; const s = window.__store.getState(); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.(); s.setManualHour?.(21); s.setLightsMode?.('on'); })()

steps.name: verify-simple-mode
steps.failMessage: App did not boot in Simple mode

steps.name: verify-lightmoodpresets-flag-simple-tier
steps.failMessage: lightMoodPresets is tier:'simple' and default:true — expected true in Simple mode

steps.name: probe-baseline-intensities
steps.eval: (() => { const scene = window.__three.scene; let lamp = 0, ceiling = 0; scene.traverse((o) => { if (!o.isPointLight) return; if (Math.abs(o.position.x - 9.6) > 0.8 || Math.abs(o.position.z - 2.6) > 0.8) return; if (o.position.y < 1.5) lamp = o.intensity; else ceiling = o.intensity; }); window.__baseline = { lamp, ceiling }; console.log('MOODPROBE baseline ' + JSON.stringify(window.__baseline)); })()

steps.name: probe-movie-intensities
steps.eval: (() => { const scene = window.__three.scene; let lamp = 0, ceiling = 0; scene.traverse((o) => { if (!o.isPointLight) return; if (Math.abs(o.position.x - 9.6) > 0.8 || Math.abs(o.position.z - 2.6) > 0.8) return; if (o.position.y < 1.5) lamp = o.intensity; else ceiling = o.intensity; }); window.__movie = { lamp, ceiling }; console.log('MOODPROBE movie ' + JSON.stringify(window.__movie)); })()

steps.name: verify-movie-dims-ceiling-harder-than-lamp

waitFor.store: (() => { const b = window.__baseline, m = window.__movie; if (!b || !m || b.lamp <= 0 || b.ceiling <= 0) return false; const lampRatio = m.lamp / b.lamp; const ceilingRatio = m.ceiling / b.ceiling; console.log('MOODPROBE ratios ' + JSON.stringify({ lampRatio, ceilingRatio })); return lampRatio < 1 && ceilingRatio < lampRatio; })()

steps.failMessage: Movie night should dim BOTH fixtures below Normal, and dim the ceiling fixture harder than the lamp

steps.name: verify-lightoff-invariant-not-relit
steps.comment: The composition invariant: a per-item lightOn='no' item must NEVER be re-lit by a mood, in ANY mood.

steps.name: verify-switched-off-lamp-stays-dark-under-entertaining

waitFor.store: (() => { const scene = window.__three.scene; let found = false; scene.traverse((o) => { if (o.isPointLight && Math.abs(o.position.x - 9.6) < 0.5 && Math.abs(o.position.z - 3.4) < 0.5) found = true; }); return !found; })()

steps.failMessage: A per-item lightOn='no' lamp must stay unlit under ANY mood (Entertaining), including the brighter presets

steps.name: mood-row-visible-flag-on
steps.failMessage: Mood row should be visible in the Scene menu while lightMoodPresets is on

steps.name: menu-closed
steps.failMessage: Escape should close the Scene menu panel

steps.name: menu-reopened
steps.failMessage: Scene menu should be open again after clicking its trigger

steps.name: mood-row-hidden-flag-off
steps.failMessage: Mood row should be hidden (with the menu genuinely open) once lightMoodPresets is turned off
